text:
sara.docs: Heads-up, I started a pass on the Quickstart 'hello-minima' tutorial. Found three small things: a dead link to the deployment checklist, a missing env var example for Windows PowerShell, and the Docker snippet uses the old SDK import path.
leo.eng: Can you paste the broken link?
sara.docs: It's in step 4, 'Deploy to Redwood'. The anchor points to `#deploy-checklist-v1` but the file's anchors were restructured last month. Current link: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/deploy#deploy-checklist-v1
mina.devex: Oof. That would cause confusion during workshops.
leo.eng: I'll hunt down the right anchor and submit a tiny patch. Also the Dockerfile in the example still does: `npm i @redwood/inference@^1` instead of `^2`.
sara.docs: Yep, and Windows note: we show `export REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=xyz` which doesn't work in PowerShell (
"setx" or "$env:REDWOOD_API_TOKEN = \"xyz\"" required). Could we add a one-liner?
mina.devex: Add short block:
```
# macOS / Linux
export REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=...
# PowerShell
$env:REDWOOD_API_TOKEN = '...'
```
leo.eng: I'll include that in the PR. Anything else?
sara.docs: Just one UX nit: the first-deploy step mentions 'use the hosted demo key' but doesn't clarify it's ephemeral. Add a reminder that demo keys expire in 24h.
ops-bot: Reminder: run docspell after merging to update cross-links.
leo.eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999 "fix(quickstart): deploy link, windows env, docker sdk"
sara.docs: Great — @mina.devex can you quick-review for wording & examples?
mina.devex: Will review and push a small wording tweak.
ops-bot: CI: docs build started (node 18).
leo.eng: pinging for merge once CI is green.
sara.docs: After merge, I'll update the onboarding checklist and send a one-line note in the weekly newsletter.
